Acetaldehyde buildup happens when your body produces acetaldehyde—a toxic compound formed when breaking down alcohol (ethanol) or inhaling smoke—faster than it can clear it . Normally, alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) converts alcohol into acetaldehyde, and aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH2) quickly converts acetaldehyde into harmless acetate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXLPljO9h77W-JNn0boK2vFeDUn89rdTHeh7_2pPA-CRZYOBTv6w-Xtw4GX67QZhbCsxWsmUTY-hzlF1IaJWn3WArzO9HU9KUJZXkNBaK9II3F9LKbHfrvqInGkp_9gZeR_iHYB2SMTe8IllYbJ-XI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wwVxyYhYdxQK_qbEmwPYyc_Lqy8myBHQ7Qw8CrZdGYnpyU_wt73t2_YcPsSXWC5T0Z27UDO7WxLd_VF_Poqf87XHafqwJtu3WfcHQSlU_BjGxAcqgPH7zb2bXxfqfX51HgjkesM3HZIqbjvo4-CcxWNMafYZ5lp8tQbs-4yJQVhRnqpNl4)

### What Causes It

- **Drinking faster than your body can process:** The liver can only metabolize roughly one standard drink per hour. Heavy or rapid drinking overwhelms ALDH2.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXoi-oM0U7vgnF-KD_YcPmzQjUC0hLzJvHVd2cxJDLZP_YMHek-OC4QS1O6mtabjrTfeZ6TP0kcit2RRiNI4ow6BgcSXDfrpBGJUP9Bf8RgAEH9nrQfvdw9DubGFhRMIW5ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXTTli43cF3V3LlSbL9tKR3TWpXRFkwB8WtdMC4yD5Dm7XFeCCgb8slwKFlrYYhfysa4I61ck7Q4yiX67N5Jnbhld1CU8t7WiZ4iASJ9Mp4bl3nXOf6dUzce0Hc2nJHUvppbI-mn1L61veCDnETlvP-tAn_kxcMw)
- **ALDH2 gene variations:** Inherited enzyme variants (common in people of East Asian descent) slow down acetaldehyde breakdown, causing alcohol intolerance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX_SPMvD5xSUeabkUGdg6ggJAfaKbXznE56bs6ylhX4HUjZt_j_CuAwS1U7Y83oexLG3jpIFnbcV4JyGkr-Wn_KGt0XFWvT4wVOQvidm7cwehUIQ2qNRvSXsAVpzdknUHf-R1frQevkPMDBnsInYU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)
- **Medications:** Drugs like disulfiram block ALDH enzymes intentionally, while certain other medications can also trigger severe reactions with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXKK_xMZveRHqhh3l0sOahtR7EH_Ep0G9mpZkbzSR37R20cYCRHQw0OVyKLqaSEf3-eSFEQCAffbjvb5bwGhspWyLjU05vjsdeHzBWksAaeS7VKoUtYd6hSJgBBe1zKvHkUg0_Cg65N3pUwA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX_SPMvD5xSUeabkUGdg6ggJAfaKbXznE56bs6ylhX4HUjZt_j_CuAwS1U7Y83oexLG3jpIFnbcV4JyGkr-Wn_KGt0XFWvT4wVOQvidm7cwehUIQ2qNRvSXsAVpzdknUHf-R1frQevkPMDBnsInYU)
- **Non-alcohol sources:** Tobacco smoke and air pollution (like diesel exhaust) introduce acetaldehyde directly into the body.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wwVxyYhYdxQK_qbEmwPYyc_Lqy8myBHQ7Qw8CrZdGYnpyU_wt73t2_YcPsSXWC5T0Z27UDO7WxLd_VF_Poqf87XHafqwJtu3WfcHQSlU_BjGxAcqgPH7zb2bXxfqfX51HgjkesM3HZIqbjvo4-CcxWNMafYZ5lp8tQbs-4yJQVhRnqpNl4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)

### Symptoms and Effects on the Body
Short-term buildup can trigger flushing, warmth, nausea, headache, rapid heart rate (palpitations), dizziness, or anxiety. Over time, repeated acetaldehyde exposure damages cells and DNA, increasing risks for liver damage, gastrointestinal irritation, and certain cancers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXLPljO9h77W-JNn0boK2vFeDUn89rdTHeh7_2pPA-CRZYOBTv6w-Xtw4GX67QZhbCsxWsmUTY-hzlF1IaJWn3WArzO9HU9KUJZXkNBaK9II3F9LKbHfrvqInGkp_9gZeR_iHYB2SMTe8IllYbJ-XI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXoi-oM0U7vgnF-KD_YcPmzQjUC0hLzJvHVd2cxJDLZP_YMHek-OC4QS1O6mtabjrTfeZ6TP0kcit2RRiNI4ow6BgcSXDfrpBGJUP9Bf8RgAEH9nrQfvdw9DubGFhRMIW5ag)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXKK_xMZveRHqhh3l0sOahtR7EH_Ep0G9mpZkbzSR37R20cYCRHQw0OVyKLqaSEf3-eSFEQCAffbjvb5bwGhspWyLjU05vjsdeHzBWksAaeS7VKoUtYd6hSJgBBe1zKvHkUg0_Cg65N3pUwA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wwVxyYhYdxQK_qbEmwPYyc_Lqy8myBHQ7Qw8CrZdGYnpyU_wt73t2_YcPsSXWC5T0Z27UDO7WxLd_VF_Poqf87XHafqwJtu3WfcHQSlU_BjGxAcqgPH7zb2bXxfqfX51HgjkesM3HZIqbjvo4-CcxWNMafYZ5lp8tQbs-4yJQVhRnqpNl4)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXJU4uT7o2kGqQRvyJ5zMpr3-rGc1BOZFRlEb87rKLyOwl2BL9whEMrxuCiTId5H5qNb52ipCB5sZX5RAi0HJ6CcI6H8i7Of0eOU9INkS0xkn6YgS2obGiigndukC8xjG-xw)

### Prevention and Management

- **Limit or avoid alcohol:** The most reliable way to prevent buildup is cutting back or abstaining.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)
- **Pace drinks:** Spacing out alcohol gives your enzymes time to clear byproducts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXoi-oM0U7vgnF-KD_YcPmzQjUC0hLzJvHVd2cxJDLZP_YMHek-OC4QS1O6mtabjrTfeZ6TP0kcit2RRiNI4ow6BgcSXDfrpBGJUP9Bf8RgAEH9nrQfvdw9DubGFhRMIW5ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXwuT0ZOyKmL0jTx3gdbt6mrdH70zLTK8P0VvOVcblGrVhUROrVBdOt7M4reBPRwWZDEpXctwKzLLvleRKNYUe3oqiTP9w10tRmKITCdDoHnq2uKtdnmt06jrduUQCMvFc7PXIqiHB_g)
- **Avoid smoke and symptom maskers:** Skip tobacco and secondhand smoke. Avoid using antihistamines or antacids just to mask flushing or stomach upset so you drink more.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wwVxyYhYdxQK_qbEmwPYyc_Lqy8myBHQ7Qw8CrZdGYnpyU_wt73t2_YcPsSXWC5T0Z27UDO7WxLd_VF_Poqf87XHafqwJtu3WfcHQSlU_BjGxAcqgPH7zb2bXxfqfX51HgjkesM3HZIqbjvo4-CcxWNMafYZ5lp8tQbs-4yJQVhRnqpNl4)
- **Check with a doctor:** Speak with a healthcare provider about bothersome reactions after drinking or potential medication interactions. You can review [Cleveland Clinic's guide on alcohol intolerance](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig) for more details on symptoms and medical next steps.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)

- **Limit or avoid alcohol:** The most reliable way to prevent buildup is cutting back or abstaining.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)
- **Pace drinks:** Spacing out alcohol gives your enzymes time to clear byproducts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXoi-oM0U7vgnF-KD_YcPmzQjUC0hLzJvHVd2cxJDLZP_YMHek-OC4QS1O6mtabjrTfeZ6TP0kcit2RRiNI4ow6BgcSXDfrpBGJUP9Bf8RgAEH9nrQfvdw9DubGFhRMIW5ag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXwuT0ZOyKmL0jTx3gdbt6mrdH70zLTK8P0VvOVcblGrVhUROrVBdOt7M4reBPRwWZDEpXctwKzLLvleRKNYUe3oqiTP9w10tRmKITCdDoHnq2uKtdnmt06jrduUQCMvFc7PXIqiHB_g)
- **Avoid smoke and symptom maskers:** Skip tobacco and secondhand smoke. Avoid using antihistamines or antacids just to mask flushing or stomach upset so you drink more.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF14ZSY8Cg7Scfhi5dwJpqUyl0AccnvBHVMFGL6KAVHZJhWo2kAKTArgjSsb7m2hZYyKcqDWyNvcOObAGeUoRLpsdcZGM2GYAX2fK43b5K4rIzisNY9CJGWhaKS00y4m5AILxHtpsK0YsLIQfHeWai8tl2Krh52UPFF2-E88-Jig)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wwVxyYhYdxQK_qbEmwPYyc_Lqy8myBHQ7Qw8CrZdGYnpyU_wt73t2_YcPsSXWC5T0Z27UDO7WxLd_VF_Poqf87XHafqwJtu3WfcHQSlU_BjGxAcqgPH7zb2bXxfqfX51HgjkesM3HZIqbjvo4-CcxWNMafYZ5lp8tQbs-4yJQVhRnqpNl4)
- **Check with a doctor:** Speak with a healthcare provider about bothersome reactions after drinking or potential medication interactions.
